styles.name: Craig Burbidge
styles.about: Late-80s/90s LA R&B, soul, gospel and pop (Barry White, Brian McKnight, Take 6, Vanessa Williams, David Tao 陶喆, 张惠妹, 王力宏, 五月天). Signature: vocal-forward, warm SSL/Neve console body, deep punchy bottom, lush plate on lead + gospel-style backgrounds, smooth opto-style lead compression, glue bus compression, wide polished stereo.

sig.lead: THE vocal stand-in: front, intimate, lush plate
sig.bg: Wide gospel-style backgrounds behind the lead
sig.master: Warm glue, polished width, musical dynamics
